svg.title: Architecture: a cloud pipeline and a local re-analysis that produce the same numbers
svg.desc: Cloud path, orchestrated by Luigi: TLC parquet and NOAA weather in Google Cloud Storage go to a PySpark job on Dataproc, which cleans trips, removes exact duplicates, keeps one weather station, drops data-gap days and aggregates per day and zone; it writes a fact table and three dimensions back to GCS, which Snowflake loads into a star schema read by the Tableau dashboard. Local path: analysis/weather_effect.py reads the same public files with DuckDB, applies the same filters and writes daily.csv and results.json, which feed the static dashboard and the README figures.
